lines: Grab a piece of paper. Draw a line down the *middle.*
#On one side, write what you can *control.*
#The economy. Other people's opinions. The *weather.* The past.
#Your effort. Your *attitude.* Your habits. What you do *next.*
#Now look at where your energy has been *going.*
For most people, it's all on the wrong *side.*
Hours spent replaying conversations you can't *change.*
When something's outside your control, *acknowledge* it.
And put everything you've got into the other *column.*
Focus on your side of the line.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Stressed About Everything? Do This.
post.caption: You can't control the wind. But you can adjust the sails. ⛵
post.first_comment: What's one thing you'll stop worrying about today? 👇
